purpose: Prevent G05 from passing on transport-only, mock, static, queued=false or cross-lineage evidence.
lineage_law: All required evidence must name or reopen the same real work lineage; evidence from unrelated canaries cannot be composed into PASS.
privacy_law: Raw command/capture literals, credentials, private packet bodies and tokens must not appear in public GitHub/gh-pages evidence.
provider_law: No provider is mandatory. Supabase may satisfy the current private transport adapter, but G05 is defined by authenticated post-claim private context and same-lineage execution evidence, not by Supabase itself.
authority_boundary: This contract only controls progress scoring. It grants no execution, promotion, Current, Human Accepted or Served authority.
